/.title: Swthastu | Wellness Retreats, Mindfulness & Wellbeing
/.description: Find your path to living well with Swthastu. Explore wellness retreat concepts, mindful rituals, guided workshops and workplace wellbeing programmes.

/about.title: About Swthastu | A Thoughtful Approach to Wellbeing
/about.description: Discover Swthastu's approach to everyday wellbeing: reflection, movement, nourishment and meaningful connection, with personal choice and clear care standards.

/journeys.title: Find Your Wellbeing Journey | Swthastu
/journeys.description: Choose a wellbeing starting point around your needs, time and life stage. Explore mindful rituals, retreat concepts or an enquiry for human support.

/retreats.title: Wellness Retreats for Families & Individuals | Swthastu
/retreats.description: Explore 13 wellness retreat concepts for families, individuals and leaders. Find space for reflection and connection, with formats and availability by enquiry.

/coaches.title: Mindfulness Coaching & Human Support | Swthastu
/coaches.description: Enquire about mindfulness coaching and wellbeing support. Share your preferred format, language and needs; credentials, fees and appointments are confirmed separately.

/living-well.title: Mindfulness Workshops & Everyday Rituals | Swthastu
/living-well.description: Explore mindfulness workshops and 64 everyday rituals for calm, energy and connection. Choose by time, need and support, with practical steps and care guidance.

/workshops.title: Wellbeing Workshops for Everyday Life | Swthastu
/workshops.description: Discover five guided wellbeing workshops on affirmations, boundaries, grief, self-love and everyday thoughts. Explore the format and enquire about participation.

/rituals.title: Mindfulness Exercises & Daily Gratitude Rituals | Swthastu
/rituals.description: Explore 64 timed wellbeing practices, from gratitude journal prompts and Mauna silent practice to setting a Sankalpa. Find steps, adaptations and care guidance.

/gatherings.title: Wellbeing Gatherings, Gratitude & Connection | Swthastu
/gatherings.description: Explore six wellbeing gathering concepts inspired by light, colour, quiet and gratitude. Discover voluntary activities, care guidance and ways to enquire.

/calendar.title: Wellbeing Calendar & Proposed Experiences | Swthastu
/calendar.description: Browse proposed wellbeing workshops, retreats and gatherings. Send an enquiry to confirm dates, locations, facilitators and participation terms before booking.

/providers.title: Provider Applications & Account | Swthastu
/providers.description: Apply to Swthastu's provider network as a coach, healer or facilitator. Review verification, consent and scope requirements before submitting your application.

/rishi.title: Rishi | Guided Wellbeing Reflection | Swthastu
/rishi.description: Explore Rishi's guided reflection preview with clear consent and privacy choices. Choose listening or reflection at your own pace, with human support by enquiry.

/sanctuary.title: My Space | Private Journal & Reflection | Swthastu
/sanctuary.description: Make room for reflection in My Space. Write a temporary private journal, choose a gentle prompt or save an encrypted copy on your device with your consent.

/partners.title: Wellbeing Partnerships for Resorts & Teams | Swthastu
/partners.description: Co-design wellbeing experiences for your resort, workplace or community. Explore family, youth and leadership concepts, with scope and care standards agreed together.

/privacy.title: Privacy & Consent Choices | Swthastu
/privacy.description: Understand Swthastu's privacy and consent choices for enquiries, provider applications, private journaling and Rishi. Learn how to request correction or deletion.

/care-standards.title: Care Standards & Service Terms | Swthastu
/care-standards.description: Read Swthastu's care standards for wellbeing experiences, coaching enquiries and workplace programmes, including suitability, safeguarding and service boundaries.

/at-work.title: Corporate Wellbeing Workshops & Programmes | Swthastu
/at-work.description: Plan corporate wellbeing workshops around everyday habits, manager capability and team connection. Discuss your workforce, delivery format and programme scope.

/at-work/eap.title: Employee Assistance Programme Design | Swthastu at Work
/at-work/eap.description: Explore Employee Assistance Programme design for your workplace. Define private support, provider qualifications, eligibility and referral pathways before launch.
